Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic's Scaled Enterprise team is a high-velocity sales motion built to bring frontier AI to a broad set of enterprise accounts. We're focused on reaching new customers efficiently, turning first conversations into real, expanding partnerships, and building the playbook for how Anthropic shows up at scale. As a Scaled Enterprise Account Executive, you'll own a book of enterprise accounts and the full revenue outcome for each. You'll generate your own pipeline, run a high-velocity sales cycle from first conversation through close, and develop a clear point of view on where Claude creates value in each account. You'll work closely with Product, Applied AI, and GTM to learn what's working at scale and feed it back into the playbook we're building from the ground up. This is a role for someone who thrives in hypergrowth, gets energy from breaking into new enterprise accounts, and wants to help build the scaled motion at Anthropic — not inherit one. Responsibilities Own all revenue outcomes for a book of enterprise accounts, driving new logo acquisition and early expansion across multiple use cases Generate the majority of your own pipeline through outbound, creative prospecting, and proactive multithreading into enterprise accounts that have not yet engaged with Anthropic Run a high-velocity sales cycle from first meeting through close, qualifying quickly, advancing rigorously, and knowing when to walk Develop a clear point of view on where Claude creates value in each account and bring that POV to technical and business stakeholders alike Build relationships with directors, VPs, and executive sponsors within your enterprise accounts, earning the right to expand by delivering early wins Negotiate and close commercial agreements involving technical evaluations, security review, and enterprise procurement Partner with Product, Applied AI, and Engineering to surface what's working, what's not, and what enterprise buyers need next Contribute to the playbook, proof points, and motion that this team is building from the ground up You may be a good fit if you have 3-5+ years selling into enterprise accounts as a full-cycle individual contributor carrying a bag, with a track record of consistently exceeding quota Experience selling at a hypergrowth company, where the playbook was still being written and you helped write it A hunter mindset and demonstrated success generating your own enterprise pipeline and breaking into new enterprise accounts Experience running enterprise sales cycles involving technical evaluations, security review, and procurement Comfort engaging both technical and business buyers at the director and VP level within enterprise organizations Background selling platform, API, cloud infrastructure, developer tools, or AI/ML into enterprise Strong commercial instincts and the ability to qualify quickly and advance rigorously Genuine interest in AI and strong alignment with Anthropic's mission of developing AI systems that are safe and beneficial What will make you stand out Experience at a hypergrowth enterprise infrastructure or developer tools company in its scaling years Track record as one of the early AEs on a new team, segment, or product where you helped build the motion rather than inherit it Background in developer tools, API, or AI/ML sales into technical buyers The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We’re looking for a highly motivated, self-starter founding Account Executive in Singapore who is passionate about voice technology and how it is changing businesses. We don’t just sell a product or custom-level solutions; we are partnering with organizations to help them generate new experiences and monetization opportunities at scale with our breakthrough voice technology. In this role you will: 1. Build and manage a growing portfolio of new accounts across industries adopting conversational AI to help ElevenLabs meet its revenue goals 2. Identify new business opportunities where ElevenLabs’ conversational AI capabilities can drive user engagement, automation, or cost efficiency 3. items.title: Offline Media Buyer
items.location_text: United States, Ireland, Croatia, Japan, Mexico, Italy, Poland, Singapore, United Kingdom, India, UAE , Canada
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE We're now looking for an Offline Media Buyer and Manager to own and scale our offline acquisition channels. This role will be hands-on in building and optimizing campaigns across CTV, podcasts, OOH, direct mail, and emerging offline channels—working cross-functionally with creative, product, and data science. You’ll have the opportunity to unlock new growth channels beyond digital, drive measurable impact on brand and performance, and connect offline efforts back to our self-serve, enterprise, and consumer funnels. We are already investing in offline marketing and want to scale this significantly with a more data-driven, experimentation-first approach. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Develop and execute offline marketing strategies across CTV, podcasts, OOH, direct mail, and other emerging channels - Own campaign planning, vendor selection, negotiation, budgeting, and performance tracking - Partner with creative teams to develop high-impact, channel-specific messaging and assets - Design and run experiments to measure incrementality and understand the true impact of offline channels - Build attribution frameworks to connect offline efforts to online conversion and revenue - Analyze performance and optimize campaigns based on reach, frequency, lift, and downstream conversion metrics - Stay up to date with trends in offline marketing, measurement methodologies, and new inventory opportunities WHO YOU ARE We're looking for exceptional individuals who combine analytical rigor with creative thinking, who are excited by hard problems and motivated by measurable impact. You’ll thrive with us if you: - Have experience planning and executing campaigns across offline channels such as CTV, podcasts, OOH, or direct mail - Think in terms of incrementality, lift, and full-funnel impact, not just impressions or reach - Are comfortable operating in ambiguity and building new channels from scratch - Have strong analytical skills and can work with imperfect data to make informed decisions - Collaborate effectively with creative, data, and product teams to bring campaigns to life - Take ownership and move quickly, balancing experimentation with execution - Communicate clearly and can translate offline performance into business outcomes WHAT WE OFFER - High-velocity innovation: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - A truly global team: Collaboration with teammates across 30+ countries, a global customer footprint and office hubs in New York, London and Warsaw. Annual company offsite for the whole team to get together (the last one in Croatia!) - Remote first: We prioritize your talent, not your location, with structured asynchronous workflows for maximum impact and minimal meetings. - Continuous growth: Collaborate with AI leaders, shape your path, and contribute where you excel most. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE As a Strategic Data & Licensing Partnerships Negotiator on the Strategic Data & Licensing Partnerships team, you will drive the acquisition of premium content and negotiate complex agreements to secure high-value data and content for AI training, RAG, and distribution. Your work will enable Mistral AI to access quality, relevant sources while building long-term relationships with publishers, universities, research institutions, and data providers. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to align content sourcing with Mistral AI’s strategic interests, ensuring innovative and ethical use of data. This role is for a results-driven negotiator who thrives in high-stakes deal-making and understands the intersection of AI, academic content, and ethical data practices. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Build and manage a pipeline of high-quality content (STEM, academic, robotics, multimedia) while vetting providers for legal and business compliance. - Negotiate complex, multi-pronged agreements (licensing, revenue-sharing, co-development) with publishers, universities, and research institutions. - Develop long-term partnerships that promote fair compensation and sustainability for content creators and owners. - Collaborate with internal teams (Science, Product, Go To Market) to align procurement with their objectives and evaluate "make vs. buy" options. - Provide regular reports and analytics on procurement activities to support data-driven decision-making. - Design programs that foster ethical and scalable content sourcing, balancing internal development with external licensing. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Proven track record negotiating and closing complex deals ($10M+), including licensing, revenue-sharing, or co-development agreements. - Deep understanding of AI training data ecosystems and the ability to translate technical needs into business terms. - Legal acumen in data acquisition and content licensing, including knowledge of global copyright laws. - Strong STEM background (degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field) and passion for academic content. - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience negotiating with C-level stakeholders. - Business acumen in market analysis and financial modeling (e.g., DCF analysis). - Fluency in English and French; additional languages (e.g., German) are a plus. - Existing network in publishing, academic, or research communities or experience with AI training data (pretraining, RAG, synthetic data). WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase . As a Prime Sales Trader on the Institutional Prime Trading team, you'll help grow one of Coinbase's most strategically important businesses by delivering best-in-class execution and liquidity solutions to the world's most sophisticated institutional clients. Our clients include asset managers, hedge funds, VCs, family offices, pensions, and endowments across both crypto-native and traditional finance. You'll drive trading volume, deepen counterparty relationships, and shape how institutional clients experience Coinbase's execution services across spot and derivatives markets. What you'll do: Drive increased trading volume by understanding clients' liquidity needs, proactively identifying how high-touch and low-touch execution services can meet those needs, and providing real-time support for execution and market color. Build and maintain trusted counterparty relationships through quality execution, daily market updates on liquidity and flow thematics, and consistent, high-quality service delivery. Partner with Sales, Financing, and Account Management teams to identify, onboard, and monetize new client relationships, proactively surfacing business opportunities across Coinbase's institutional product suite. Provide structured feedback from clients and the broader marketplace to institutional Product Managers, guiding new product development across spot trading and financing. Maintain a real-time pulse on market sentiment, trading activity, and client positioning, keeping relevant internal teams informed to support strategic decision-making. Required Skills and Experience: 3+ years of sales and/or trading experience in digital assets, FX, equities, credit, or derivatives at a top-tier institution, with direct experience in daily execution and settlement functions. Strong options trading capability, including pricing, hedging, and risk-managing vanilla and/or exotic structures, with fluency in Greeks, volatility dynamics, and options market microstructure. Proven ability to build and maintain counterparty relationships with institutional clients, translating market insight into trusted, high-value interactions. Experience producing institutional-grade market commentary or client communications covering macro, crypto, or digital asset themes. Weekend availability required - this role operates on a schedule that includes Saturday and Sunday as working days. Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. items.title: Growth Marketing, Creative and Ad Operations
items.location_text: San Francisco, New York City, Seattle
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Growth team drives user and revenue growth across ChatGPT’s consumer and business segments as well as other OpenAI products worldwide. We operate across the full funnel - from awareness and acquisition through activation, retention, and expansion - using a combination of global performance marketing, AI-powered workflows, in-product optimization, insights, experimentation, and creative ops engineering. Our Growth Marketing team is a rapidly scaling functional area, accelerating growth by connecting out-of-product and in-product experiences into seamless journeys that acquire, retain, and re-engage users, unlocking ChatGPT’s transformative potential in users’ daily lives. We work cross-functionally with product, engineering, design, data science, finance, and marketing to unlock scalable growth levers and deliver measurable impact across diverse markets. This team thrives on rapid testing, rigorous measurement, and creative problem solving, all while keeping user value at the center of our decision-making. ABOUT THE ROLE In this role, you will build and run the creative and advertising operations system that powers OpenAI’s paid marketing programs. You will connect Creative and Growth Marketing teams, establish clear processes for producing and launching high-quality ads, and keep the operational details behind paid campaigns organized, accurate, and scalable. You will help translate growth priorities into creative briefs and testing roadmaps, coordinate assets and approvals across internal teams and external partners, and turn performance results into clear next steps. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Build and manage the end-to-end paid creative operating system, including creative intake, briefing, production, asset delivery, approvals, trafficking, launch, reporting, and iteration. - Serve as the day-to-day connector between Creative, Brand, Growth Marketing, agencies, and production partners, keeping priorities and timelines clear and on track. - Partner with Growth Marketing to build and maintain creative testing roadmaps, translating campaign goals, audience insights, and performance data into briefs, hypotheses, test plans, and clear success metrics. - Develop and maintain the tools and processes that keep creative production organized, including asset libraries, production calendars, naming conventions, tagging, version control, specifications, and documentation. - Track creative test results, document learnings, and partner with Growth Marketing and Creative to identify what is working, what needs to change, and what should be tested next. - Continuously improve workflows, templates, reporting, and automation to increase creative throughput, reduce errors, and make paid marketing operations more efficient and reliable. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - 7+ years of experience in creative operations, growth or performance marketing, integrated marketing, or a related role supporting paid marketing programs. - Exceptional attention to detail and operational rigor, with a track record of owning high precision work in either creative or campaign operations. - Experience building or improving creative production workflows, project trackers, asset libraries, approval processes, and other systems that help teams execute consistently. - Hands-on familiarity with major paid advertising platforms such as Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit, or LinkedIn, including campaign trafficking, asset requirements, and launch QA. - Working knowledge of marketing tracking and measurement, including UTMs, pixels, conversion events, platform reporting, and basic campaign or creative performance analysis. - Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines, keep stakeholders aligned, surface risks early, and follow through on details. - Clear written and verbal communication, strong cross-functional collaboration skills, and the ability to turn growth priorities into actionable briefs, testing plans, and next steps. - Comfort working in a fast-moving environment and a proactive, resourceful approach to solving problems; experience with billing, invoicing, vendor management, or workflow automation is a plus. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. items.description: Kalshi is defining a new category Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history. Kalshi is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more. We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position. Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet. Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets. Building a new category is hard… like really hard. But it’s beautiful and deeply fulfilling . Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets. About Kalshi Kalshi is building the next generation of financial markets — where people can trade on what they think will happen. From economic events to cultural trends, Kalshi lets traders take positions on real-world outcomes. Our mission is to make trading events as natural and intuitive as trading stocks. We’re growing fast and looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to help scale our user acquisition and engagement engine. You’ll own experimentation across digital channels, optimize the user funnel, and help turn curiosity into active trading. If you’re obsessed with performance data, creative testing, and building growth systems from the ground up, this role is for you. What You’ll Do Own paid acquisition across channels like Google, Meta, YouTube, affiliates, and influencer partnerships — driving efficient growth and lowering CAC. Test, learn, and scale — run continuous experiments across creatives, landing pages, and audience segments to improve signups and first-trade conversion. Partner cross-functionally with product, lifecycle, and data teams to optimize onboarding and retention flows. Develop high-impact campaigns that connect real-world events to trading opportunities on Kalshi. Analyze performance across every stage of the funnel — from awareness through deposit and trade — and build strategies that move the needle. Report on growth metrics to leadership with clear insights and recommendations for budget allocation and scaling decisions. Move fast. We test ideas weekly and double down on what works. What You’ll Bring 6+ years in growth or performance marketing , ideally in fintech, consumer trading, or high-growth tech managing large budgets. Deep experience managing digital acquisition programs (paid search, social, programmatic, affiliates, or influencers). Strong understanding of user funnels, attribution, and experimentation frameworks . Experience with A/B Testing and lift measurement. SQL knowledge. Analytical mindset — comfortable digging into data to diagnose performance and find leverage points. Experience working with creative, data, and product teams to drive measurable results. A bias for action — you’re resourceful, fast, and thrive on solving ambiguous growth problems. Nice to Have Experience working with AI in marketing context. Experience marketing to retail investors or active traders Familiarity with event-driven trading or prediction markets . Comfort working in a regulated or compliance-driven environment. Interest in financial markets, news, and real-world events. Commitment to Equal Opportunity Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.

items.description: Kalshi is defining a new category Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history. Kalshi is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more. We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position. Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet. Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets. Building a new category is hard… like really hard. But it’s beautiful and deeply fulfilling . Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets. About the Role We’re looking for a Partnerships Manager focused on social media to help Kalshi break into culture and scale through partnerships with the right creators, influencers, and media accounts. You’ll be responsible for identifying great partners, building relationships, negotiating smart deals, and launching high-impact campaigns that resonate across social platforms. This role can span multiple channels - X, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Twitch, and more - and is perfect for someone who is deeply immersed in internet culture and knows how to spot what’s about to go viral. What You’ll Do Scout & Source: Identify creators, influencers, and accounts that align with Kalshi’s mission and voice. Build & Negotiate: Initiate conversations, cultivate relationships, and secure impactful deals. Launch Campaigns: Partner with creators to roll out activations that drive reach, virality, and user growth. Experiment Across Platforms: Test partnerships on different channels and double down on what works. Track & Optimize: Measure performance, report results, and continuously refine partnership strategies. Who’s a Good Fit Chronically online. You’re plugged into internet culture 24/7 and know where trends start. Well-connected. You’ve got a rolodex of creators or know how to reach them fast. Virality radar. You can instinctively tell what will catch fire online. Deal-maker. You’re comfortable structuring partnerships that balance creativity with business value. Commitment to Equal Opportunity Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.

items.location_text: New York, New York, United States
items.description: Kalshi is defining a new category Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history. Kalshi is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more. We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position. Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet. Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets. Building a new category is hard… like really hard. But it’s beautiful and deeply fulfilling . Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets. Role Roadmap We are building a novel asset class while scaling up a marketplace for people to trade it (the exchange). As with all meaningful inventions, mass adoption requires value prop refining, education, and trust building. Scaling a new asset class requires both creativity (art) and hardcore discipline (science). We are building our growth team, a cross-functional team of artists and scientists to tackle the uncharted territory of scaling events trading. As one of the first dedicated performance marketers on the team, you'll help shape and structure our paid growth strategy by refinding and iterating our value props and messaging in. We are an incredibly content-rich platform: we have over 500 markets and a market for any trending topic out there (Sam Altman leaving OpenAI, Fed cutting rates, Oscars, Biden Approbal, etc.). We are looking to build a dynamic growth machine that capitalizes on trends and viral markets on a weekly basis. Your responsibilities will include: Lead, iterate, run, and maintain all paid growth efforts, including FB/Instagram, Twitter, and Tiktok Run our AdWords bidding strategy (with a goal to improve our SEO) Establish disciplined end-to-end tracking for our funnel based on different channels Improve customer attribution and refine our understanding of customer segments Test and iterate on our messaging and value props Efficiently scale and manage our paid spend budget (5 to 7 figures) Develop creatives and visuals in collaboration with design Create market-specific campaigns targeted at the right audiences (economics, Oscars, tech, AI, etc.) Leverage AI to develop personalized campaigns (why not) Be bold, make big bets, and have fun. Who You Are A scientist at heart who is maniacally disciplined and obsessive about experimenting. A big plus if you're also creative and have crazy ideas. You'll thrive in this role if you deeply care about what you produce, you want ownership and freedom (we're low on process and BS politics), know how to be scrappy and finesse your way around the world, and thrive in a (ridiculously) fast-paced environment. Some other basic requirements: 3+ years of experience in performance marketing, digital marketing, or a similar role (this is not necessary) Proven track record of driving growth and user acquisition for online products Strong analytical skills and data fluency Proficient with Facebook/Instagram, Google, Twitter, and Tiktok Excellent judgment on task prioritizations Growth mindset, with a high slope and eagerness to lean Love of the craft: you genuinely care and put your all into your work Can ship at incredible speed (very simple) Bonus: have worked in the gaming industry before. These are the primary responsibilities of the role; however, there is endless green field at Kalshi: if you're ambitious and bold, it's yours to take. Should you have compensation expectations that exceed these bands, we'd love to hear from you and would welcome you to reach out to discuss further. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets. Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM OpenAI’s Consumer Verticals team builds experiences that make ChatGPT more useful in the areas that matter to people every day. Within Travel, we’re exploring how AI can help people discover destinations, compare options, and plan trips around their preferences and needs. Travel planning brings together inspiration, personal preferences, and practical constraints—from budgets and schedules to changing prices and availability. We aim to make that complexity easier to navigate, combining advanced AI capabilities, relevant travel information, and thoughtful product design to help people move from an idea to a trip with greater confidence. We work closely with product, design, research, safety, privacy, and other ChatGPT teams to turn emerging AI capabilities into useful consumer experiences, with a high bar for quality, reliability, and user trust. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a product-minded full stack software engineer to help shape the next generation of travel experiences in ChatGPT. You will own features end-to-end, from early exploration and prototypes through launch and iteration. Your work will span intuitive interfaces, backend services, and integrations that connect conversational experiences with travel information and services. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy shaping new product areas, making complex information intuitive, and moving quickly from idea to production. Prior experience in AI or travel is not required. IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL - Build consumer travel experiences across ChatGPT’s web and mobile surfaces, with ownership spanning frontend interfaces, backend services, and external integrations. - Translate travelers’ preferences and constraints into useful experiences for discovering destinations, comparing stays and transportation, and planning itineraries. - Build integrations with travel data and services - Partner with product, design, and research to turn AI capabilities into intuitive, personalized products and shape what to build next. - Design reliable experiences that handle incomplete information, and service failures while giving users clear choices and control. - Improve quality, performance, and usability through experimentation and user feedback, with privacy, safety, and user trust built into the product. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU - Have 10+ years of software engineering experience, with depth in full-stack development. - Have shipped consumer products at scale and can own features across interfaces, APIs, services, and data flows. - Bring strong product judgment and a high bar for craft, especially when making complex choices easy to understand. - Enjoy shaping product direction and owning ambiguous problems from idea to production. - Move quickly while making thoughtful tradeoffs around quality, reliability, and user trust. - Are excited to apply AI to travel and help people turn their preferences and plans into useful next steps. BONUS IF YOU HAVE - Experience with AI-powered applications, conversational interfaces, or multimodal products. - Experience building travel, marketplace, commerce including integrations with external providers. - Experience with personalization, search and discovery, or systems that depend on frequently changing data. - Experience with privacy-sensitive products, secure data flows, permissions, or user consent. items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic exists to ensure the world safely navigates the transition through transformative AI. That work is funded by commercial revenue — and every dollar of it runs through Billing Platform. We build and operate the infrastructure that turns product usage into revenue across everything Anthropic ships: Claude.ai, the Developer Platform, Claude Code, and all that comes next. The faster we can price it, charge for it, and account for it correctly, the faster Anthropic can fund the mission. Pricing Foundations is the team within Billing that turns a signed enterprise agreement into something every system can act on. We own the model and the systems of record for what a customer bought: their commitments, their pricing terms, how many organizations roll up to one agreement, and the automation that provisions a signed deal across Anthropic's products and the cloud platforms where Claude is sold. When a deal closes, our systems decide what the customer is entitled to, what they pay, and what Finance reports. We're looking for an engineering manager to lead this team. You'll hire and grow the team, set its technical direction, and own how it delivers. Success looks like new deal structures shipping as configuration rather than one-off engineering, and signed deals provisioning automatically, with the rare exception routed to someone who can fix it. Key responsibilities Lead and grow the team. Hire, coach, and develop engineers, give clear and honest feedback, and build a team that owns its domain end to end. Own the commercial data model. Set the direction for how commitments, pricing terms, account hierarchies, and entitlements are modeled, so a new deal structure extends the model instead of working around it. Own the pricing primitives: the catalog of products and rates, and the constructs that let contracted pricing follow a customer across products and new model launches. Make the contract the source of truth. Build systems of record that Finance can close the books on and trace back to the signed contract, with reconciliation against the CRM and every downstream billing system designed in from the start. Automate the path from signature to a live customer. Lead the durable workflows that provision a signed deal across Anthropic's products and the cloud platforms where Claude is sold, recover from partial failure, and route exceptions to the right person with the context to resolve them. Build for people and agents. Own the interfaces for agreements, entitlements, and pricing terms that seller tools and Claude-powered agents read and write, so both get the same safe, auditable capabilities. Own planning and delivery. Turn competing asks from Sales, Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, and product teams into a clear roadmap, make the trade-offs explicit, and hold the team to its milestones. Operate what you ship. Set SLOs on the flows your team runs, instrument them so discrepancies surface before month-end close, and keep on-call sustainable as volume grows. Minimum qualifications 8+ years of industry experience, including 3+ years leading software engineering teams including hiring, coaching and performance management. A strong background building production backend systems, with enough depth in a language such as Go, Python, or Java to review designs and code. Experience leading teams that built billing, payments, pricing, contract management, or other financial systems of record in production. Experience modeling transactional or financial data, including relational databases and SQL. Experience leading teams that built and operated asynchronous, long-running workflows, such as on a durable workflow engine like Temporal or on queues and state machines. Preferred qualifications Experience building CPQ, contract management, or quote-to-cash platforms, and firsthand knowledge of how one change to pricing terms ripples through quoting, provisioning, invoicing, and revenue reporting. Experience with enterprise commercial structures such as multi-year or ramped commitments, drawdowns, amendments and renewals, or one agreement shared across many accounts. Experience integrating or extending third-party billing, payment, or CRM platforms, and opinions on where they fall short. Experience building revenue reconciliation or financial reporting pipelines, or systems that had to pass a financial audit. Experience automating a high-touch operational process and measuring the manual work it removed. Experience building LLM-powered tools or agents, or systems designed for agents to call safely. Experience growing a team through a period of rapid company growth. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $405,000 — $485,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. This role sits at the intersection of applied social science, AI, and product policy. Their work will inform product and policy decisions and, where appropriate, contribute to external publications. We are looking for a hands-on empirical social scientist with exceptional methodological judgment. items.title: Director and Associate General Counsel, Banking and Credit Cards
items.location_text: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Washington, DC
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. We’re looking for a Director & Associate General Counsel, Banking and Credit Cards, to join our Legal team. This role is a key part of Robinhood’s legal leadership and will function as a hands-on legal advisor while also managing a small team of attorneys. The ideal candidate will serve as a strategic partner to our Banking and Credit Card business, and work cross-functionally with Robinhood’s other regulated businesses. This is a high-impact role for a legal leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment, can think across multiple regulatory frameworks, and is passionate about building and mentoring legal talent. This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA, New York, NY, or Washington, DC office(s), with in-person attendance expected 5 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Lead and manage a team of attorneys supporting Robinhood’s Banking and Credit Card business. Provide practical, solutions-oriented legal advice to cross-functional teams on a broad range of regulatory issues affecting banking, deposit accounts, payments, and credit cards. Partner closely with compliance, product, operations, and executive leadership to identify legal risks and drive mitigation strategies. Support regulatory engagement and examinations as needed. Help build scalable legal processes, frameworks and controls to support a rapidly evolving financial technology company. Mentor and grow team members while promoting a strong culture of collaboration, accountability, and inclusion. What you bring J.D. and membership in at least one U.S. state bar in good standing. 10+ years of relevant legal experience, with a strong background in consumer financial regulatory law, including, for example, banking, deposit accounts, payments, and credit. Experience managing legal professionals or cross-functional teams, with a track record of developing talent and delivering results. Ability to navigate complex legal and regulatory issues while delivering clear, risk-based, actionable guidance. Experience advising business and product teams on compliance with Truth in Lending Act (Reg Z), Truth in Savings Act (Reg DD), Electronic Fund Transfer Act (Reg E), Fair Credit Reporting Act (Reg V), Equal Opportunity Credit Act (Reg B), UDAAP under Dodd-Frank and UDAP under FTC Act, payment network rules (including NACHA and card networks), TCPA and CAN-SPAM, Expedited Funds Availability Act (Reg CC), Bank Secrecy Act/AML/OFAC Sanctions, laws governing rewards programs, and laws governing first- and third-party collections, including the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (Reg F). Experience advising business and product teams on legal issues affecting fintech-bank partnerships, including state licensing (lending, marketing, brokering, servicing, collections), usury, interest exportation, and contractual obligations under governing program and sponsorship agreements. Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth, and highly regulated environment. Strong communication skills and a business-oriented mindset. Demonstrated ability to quickly develop fluency in new substantive areas and effectively lead and collaborate with team members who bring deep subject-matter expertise. Leadership expectations Our ambitious roadmap requires a great culture shaped by exceptional leaders. Here’s what we expect from them: Drive high performance by setting clear, focused goals, giving real-time feedback, stretching top talent, and scaling impact through focus, innovation, and tech. Hire and retain top talent by setting a high bar, hiring only those who raise it, investing in onboarding, and addressing talent issues quickly and fairly. Create community by connecting work to purpose, removing friction while prioritizing safety, building trust and inclusion, and leading from the front with integrity. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more. Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. items.description: Our Compliance Governance team is responsible for ensuring that our organization complies with applicable laws, regulations, and industry standards. About the role We are seeking an experienced, hands-on strategic and operational leader to head the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) globally across every jurisdiction where Crypto.com operates. This role owns the end-to-end global financial crime transaction monitoring and investigation lifecycle, functioning as an integrated process chain spanning strategy, policy and procedure design, transaction monitoring rules design and management, transaction monitoring technology, Level 1 quality and SLA governance, Level 2 complex investigations, risk mitigation decisions, and SAR/STR filings across sanctions, AML/CFT, fraud, and complex fiat/crypto typologies. You will set the global strategy, policies, and implementation procedures; continuously adapt the program to evolving financial crime risks; and assess Crypto.com’s overall transactional financial crime risk posture. Combining deep financial crime expertise with rigorous operational and process discipline, you will directly lead the global rules design, transaction monitoring, investigations, and SARs teams across North America, EMEA, and APAC, while exercising functional oversight over Level 1 alert operations by setting their procedures, monitoring their SLAs, and governing their output quality. You will own our transaction monitoring platforms, maintain real-time operational dashboards, and remain directly involved in complex casework, data analysis, and written work product. Additionally, the role includes interfacing with regulators during examinations and supporting law enforcement and financial intelligence unit engagements. Reporting to the SVP, Compliance in the US, you will partner closely with regional compliance teams, Operations, Data, and Product leadership to keep Crypto.com’s defenses ahead of emerging threats. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. Robinhood Derivatives, LLC (RHD) is Robinhood's CFTC-regulated futures commission merchant and NFA member, offering customers access to futures, options on futures, and event contracts. The RHD Compliance team is small, hands-on, and in build mode. We partner with Legal, Risk, Operations, Product, and Engineering to launch new derivatives products the right way, with clear regulations helping us build, innovate, and scale with confidence. As the Futures Compliance Senior Specialist, you will directly report to the Chief Compliance Officer of RHD and be a core member of the team. You will help run and strengthen the day-to-day compliance program for our futures business, from policies and supervision to product reviews, marketing approvals, and regulatory interactions. This is a hands-on role for someone who knows futures regulation well and wants to help shape a program as the business grows. This role is based in our Chicago, IL office , with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. What you’ll do Support the design, operation, and ongoing testing of the RHD compliance program under the Commodity Exchange Act, CFTC regulations, and NFA rules Draft, update, and maintain Written Supervisory Procedures (WSPs), policies, and internal controls as products, rules, and business processes change Advise Product, Engineering, Operations, and Legal on the regulatory requirements for new and existing futures, options on futures, and event contract offerings, including customer-facing flows and disclosures Review and approve marketing, social media, and other communications for compliance with NFA and CFTC standards, working through our Red Oak review workflow Complete regulatory and exchange responses, including timely, accurate responses to NFA, CFTC, exchange, and clearing firm examinations, inquiries, and document requests, and track remediation of any findings through to closure Handle the registration process for Associated Persons (APs), including Series 3 testing and registration and the filing of NFA Forms 8-R (registration) and 8-T (termination) in NFA's Online Registration System, and keep AP registration records current Respond to 4g requests Support regulatory filings and recurring obligations, including the NFA annual self-examination and required notices and reports Support the firm's risk management program requirements under CFTC Regulation 1.11, and contribute to compliance monitoring, testing, and reporting to senior management Review and escalate trade surveillance and monitoring alerts, working with Risk, Trading, and Operations to investigate and document outcomes Own the customer complaint adjudication process for the futures business, from intake and investigation through resolution, documentation, and trend reporting Support KYC and customer onboarding processes as they relate to the futures business Track CFTC, NFA, and exchange rule changes and industry developments, and translate them into clear, practical guidance for the business Contribute to the annual CCO report, Board reporting, and compliance training for RHD personnel What you bring 3-5 years of compliance experience in financial services, with direct experience in futures and derivatives at an FCM, introducing broker, exchange, clearing firm, or regulator (NFA or CFTC) Active NFA Series 3 (National Commodity Futures Examination) is not required, but a nice-to-have. Ability to obtain it within 90 days of hire is required. Working knowledge of the Commodity Exchange Act, CFTC regulations, and NFA rules, including supervision requirements (such as NFA Compliance Rule 2-9) and communications and promotional material standards Experience supporting regulatory examinations, document requests, and responses to findings Experience drafting and maintaining WSPs, policies, and compliance procedures Ability to read complex rules, form a clear view, and give practical, well-documented guidance to product, engineering, and business partners who move fast Strong written and verbal communication skills, with sound judgment and high attention to detail What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. Base Pay Range: Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC) $140,000 — $165,000 USD Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL) $123,000 — $145,000 USD Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL) $110,000 — $129,000 USD Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

items.title: Technical Program Manager, Life Sciences Research (Genetic Medicine)
items.location_text: Boston, MA; San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Thousands of rare genetic diseases have a known cause but no approved treatment. Advances in gene editing and oligonucleotide medicines have made it possible to design therapies for very small populations, sometimes for a single patient, but developing them remains slow and costly. Anthropic’s Life Sciences team is exploring how frontier AI, combined with deep drug development expertise and strong external partnerships, can help change that. We’re hiring a Technical Program Manager to bring structure and momentum to this work. You’ll coordinate across programs that support the development of individualized genetic medicines, advance research into new therapeutic approaches, and help patient organizations, non-profits, and researchers use Claude in their own rare disease work. You’ll partner closely with scientists, engineers, clinicians, and external collaborators to keep complex efforts moving toward shared milestones. Much of this work remains in early stages, so this is a foundational role on a small team. You’ll help define how the team operates, build the plans and processes that allow it to grow, and work with our researchers and engineers to find where Claude can be most useful. If you’ve run complex programs in drug development or clinical research and want to help advance treatments for rare disease, we’d love to hear from you. Key responsibilities Build and own an integrated program plan, including milestones, dependencies, risks, budgets, and key decisions Coordinate with clinical, manufacturing, and research partners on programs that span preclinical development, manufacturing, regulatory review, and clinical care Run the operating cadence with external partners, tracking progress and raising risks early Work with Legal, Finance, and Partnerships to turn agreements into clear operating plans and track commitments Coordinate research across internal scientists, academic collaborators, companies, and contract research organizations, helping to scope projects, sequence work, and support timely decisions Help ensure that data is shared responsibly and in a usable form, with appropriate consent, privacy protections, and data-sharing agreements in place Lead programs that support non-profits, patient organizations, and academic and independent researchers, from onboarding through ongoing support and feedback Help connect genetic diagnosis efforts with therapeutic research and development Share insights from partners and programs with Anthropic’s research and product teams to help improve Claude for scientific and medical research Write clear status updates, risk assessments, and decision memos, and build processes that scale with the team Minimum qualifications Experience as a technical program manager or program lead on complex drug development, clinical research, or translational science programs involving multiple external organizations, such as manufacturers, contract research organizations, or clinical sites Working knowledge of how a therapy moves from preclinical development into the clinic, including manufacturing, regulatory filings, and clinical operations, and how a delay in one stage affects the others Scientific fluency in molecular biology or genetics, sufficient to follow experimental plans, review data with scientists, and understand tradeoffs Strong program management skills, including project planning, milestones, risk registers, budget tracking, and dependency management across many concurrent workstreams A track record of driving work to completion across organizations without formal authority Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to make complex scientific and operational issues easy to understand and act on Comfort working with ambiguity and building process where none exists Excitement about Anthropic’s mission to build safe and beneficial AI Preferred qualifications An advanced degree in a life science, engineering, or related field Experience with gene therapy, gene editing, or oligonucleotide programs, especially individualized (N-of-1) or ultra-rare disease programs Clinical operations experience, such as multi-site trials, master protocols, IRB submissions, or site activation Experience managing sponsored research agreements, grants, or philanthropic funding with academic institutions Experience working with patient advocacy groups, rare disease foundations, or other non-profits Familiarity with clinical genomics and genetic diagnosis Experience with patient data governance, including consent, HIPAA, and data-sharing agreements Experience in a role that bridges software or AI and the life sciences Experience as an early hire on a new team, helping define how it operates Hands-on experience using LLM tools like Claude in your day-to-day work The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $290,000 — $365,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.
